name: Steve Bisciotti

views.text: I give a head coach many years when he wins, but the standard here is championships, not playoff trips.
My general manager runs the search; I want a thorough process, not a fast one.
A former assistant who knows our values can lead the next era.
A slow start can be survived; missing the playoffs with this quarterback cannot be repeated.
Stability is our advantage, and I change course only after a full evaluation.
The draft is where this franchise was built and where I expect it to keep winning.

signatures: announces big decisions in a written statement first
credits the thoroughness of the process

motivation.fear: letting a great quarterback's prime pass without a title

want.text: a second Lombardi Trophy of the Lamar Jackson era

voice: Measured and reflective, more comfortable in a statement than a soundbite. Calls hard decisions hard. Speaks of organizational values and the people who carry them.

evidence.summary: Bisciotti fired John Harbaugh after 18 seasons following an 8-9 year without a playoff berth, saying in a statement it was an incredibly difficult decision after a full evaluation.
Baltimore hired Chargers DC Jesse Minter after a search led by GM Eric DeCosta that interviewed 16 candidates; Bisciotti praised the thorough process and Minter's grasp of team values.
Context: the team had not returned to the Super Bowl in the Jackson years, and the change was framed as ending postseason stagnation.
